translation.name: The Orthodox Jewish Bible
translation.englishName: The Orthodox Jewish Bible -  Tanakh and Orthodox Jewish Brit Chadasha - The Holy Bible

content: This is the Sefer Toldot Adam. In the yom that barah Elohim Adam, in the demut Elohim He made him;
Zachar and nekevah He created them; and blessed them, and called the shem of them “Adam,” in the yom when they were created.
And Adam lived a hundred and thirty shanah and fathered in his own demut and after his tzelem (image) and called shmo Shet:
And the days of Adam after he had fathered Shet were shemoneh me'ot shanah; and he fathered banim and banot:
And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty shanah: and he died.
And Shet lived a hundred and five shanah, and fathered Enosh;
And Shet lived after he fathered Enosh eight hundred and seven shanah, and fathered banim and banot:
And all the days of Shet were nine hundred and twelve shanah; and he died.
And Enosh lived ninety shanah, and fathered Kenan;
And Enosh lived after he fathered Kenan eight hundred and fifteen shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
And all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five shanim; and he died.
And Kenan lived seventy shanah and fathered Mahalal'el;
And Kenan lived after he fathered Mahalal'el eight hundred and forty shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
And all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten shanim; and he died.
And Mahalal'el lived sixty and five shanah, and fathered Yered;
And Mahalal'el lived after he fathered Yered eight hundred and thirty shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
And all the days of Mahalal'el were eight hundred ninety and five shanah; and he died.
And Yered lived a hundred sixty and two shanah, and he fathered Chanokh (Enoch):
And Yered lived after he fathered Chanokh (Enoch) eight hundred shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
And all the days of Yered were nine hundred sixty and two shanah; and he died.
And Chanokh lived sixty and five shanah, and fathered Metushelach;
And Chanokh walked with HaElohim after he fathered Metushelach three hundred shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
And all the days of Chanokh were three hundred sixty and five shanah;
And Chanokh walked with HaElohim; and he was not; for Elohim took him.
And Metushelach lived a hundred eighty and seven shanah, and fathered Lamech.
And Metushelach lived after he fathered Lamech seven hundred eighty and two shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
And all the days of Metushelach were nine hundred sixty and nine shanah; and he died.
And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two shanah and fathered ben;
And he called shmo Noach, saying, Zeh yenachamenu (this shall comfort us) in our work and toil of our hands, because of the adamah which Hashem hath cursed.
And Lamech lived after he fathered Noach five hundred ninety and five shanah, and fathered banim and banot;
And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven shanah; and he died.
And Noach was five hundred years old; and Noach fathered Shem, Cham, and Yephet.
